description: Authoritative server core: tick loop, ECS world, WebSocket gateway, persistence (slices 1.2+)
name: @mmo-engine/engine-core

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/schema && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/art && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/world-server && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/scatter && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/picg && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/rules && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/wfc && npm run build --workspace=@mmo-engine/placement && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --expose-gc --test --test-skip-pattern="latency budget" "dist/test/**/*.test.js" && npm run test:perf
